updates.assessment: Exact independently staged search page Manage Tags default, with tag/subtag/count type, remembered text/count order, siblings/tags and namespace grouping; default tag/ASC/siblings/user-grouped. Typed legacy context 1 imports independently of sidebar/viewer sorts. Apply merges only the changed context, Cancel preserves it, real Store reopen restores it. Native selected-file main launch reads this default at opening; every local service tab captures its own control. Local sorting retains logical tags/counts/segmented colours and uses sibling ideals only when decorators are enabled. Later policy changes leave open controls/local overrides intact; successors read the new policy. Hidden/retired sort callbacks cannot change drafts; rebind and accepted main close cancel owned children/workers, Exit Cancel retains them, and closed/re-shown viewer launchers remain inert. Stacked native sort/group dropdowns now receive intrinsic row height. Authored real-frame checks cover four contexts with initial and saved/reopened values at900x640 and1000x850, within-row containment, strict dropdown/row separation, namespace heading clearance and actual narrow-view scrolling. Separate asserted captures show the selected-files search-page and current-file media-viewer Manage Tags consumers.

Native uses existing core human/numeric ordering and segmented rendering; the implementation changes sort keys without replacing logical storage tags. Existing sidebar/media-viewer tag-display sorts remain separate.

Qt parent PNG is initial/default; saved native parent captures show applied values. Native choices remain vertical rather than horizontal. New separate Manage Tags consumer PNGs have recorded behavior support but no corresponding Qt consumer PNG; no pixel equality or parent-family credit.

Represented Options sort rows use intrinsic allocation with strict actual-widget geometry assertions for initial/applied narrow/normal states and real scroll access. Qt parent default state differs from native saved/applied captures; native vertical layout differs from Qt horizontal layout. No equal-state pixel/font or OS-key transport claim.

No matching standalone Qt populated Edit or Manage Tags consumer PNG exists; defining native exports are grounded in recorded state and assertions. Optional Qt client API listener startup was sandbox-denied in these direct Qt/DB reruns; complete fixtures matched with exit0/normal shutdown, and no API connectivity validation is claimed.

No matching standalone Qt image exists for populated Edit or the Manage Tags consumers. Native exports are grounded in recorded state and assertions. The optional Qt client API listener was denied by the sandbox during these direct Qt/DB reruns. Complete fixtures matched, both recorders exited with code 0 and shut down normally, and no API connectivity validation is claimed.

The standalone Manage Tags consumer images show the current logical tag counts, decorations and controls. The related suggestion pane was captured while searching, so no related-pane or broader Manage Tags workflow or rendering credit is granted. Exact fixture, row and source assertions establish the distinct selected-files/search-page and current-one-file/viewer contexts; identical control captions alone do not establish that distinction.

Validation is Linux only; Windows and macOS are deferred. Exactly four original leaves are approved. No completion credit is granted to Options, tag-sort or namespace families, aliases, new IDs, Paste, the ordered queue, generic Manage Tags or repository workflows, immediate viewer commits, the namespace parser or tag-display chooser, radio or global keyboard behavior, or additional consumers.

At 900 px, some namespace-grouping explanatory prose clips horizontally at line ends. The selected sort controls, queue action buttons and dedicated Add/Edit messages remain readable. Broader parent prose and pixel parity are not claimed.

Geometry tests pass for all four actual sort contexts, in default and saved states at the natural viewports. They require finite positive frames, containment within allocated rows, separation within and between rows, and separation from the actual kind-0 namespace heading. Real wheel scrolling is validated. Upper clipping in scrolled frames and a lower queue outside the viewport in unscrolled frames are deliberate pane states. The internal queue viewport does not show all rows simultaneously; exact rows, raw values and identities are established by assertions.

The native vertical stacks differ from Qt horizontal rows. Native font, button and footer proportions, the compact Qt blank entry versus the 520×220 native entry, and saved versus default parent states remain explicit differences. Whole-dialog pixel or geometry equality, OS chrome, modality, focus and universal keyboard transport equivalence are not claimed.
